hints.title: Existing Ones Condition
hints.text: If the array already contains one or more ones, each non-one can be converted to one in exactly one step.

hints.title: Shortest Coprime Subarray
hints.text: If no ones exist, find the shortest contiguous subarray whose greatest common divisor equals 1.

hints.title: Total Spread Operations
hints.text: If the shortest coprime subarray has length L, it takes L - 1 operations to create the first 1, and then n - 1 steps to turn every other element into 1.

hints.title: Shortest GCD Subarray Implementation

complexity.notes: Shortest subarray GCD scan with logarithmic Euclidean step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General search without subarray property explores exponential states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Distinguishes existing 1s case from finding the shortest gcd=1 subarray.
